name: VMware Certified Professional - Data Center Virtualization
name_ja: VMware認定プロフェッショナル（データセンター仮想化）

logistics.format: Proctored multiple-choice exam (Pearson VUE), single answer / multiple selection / matching / drag-and-drop

formal: Recommended: vSphere Install, Configure, Manage course or 6-12 months of vSphere admin experience

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Japanese availability and a one-year vSphere administration profile support associate infrastructure knowledge; the Professional title does not overcome multiple-choice testing and limited security focus.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded production relevance and a one-year administration profile support associate virtualization knowledge. The Professional title does not override the multiple-choice format, entry experience and general infrastructure scope.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded one-year vSphere role and industry deployment relevance support associate infrastructure knowledge. I discount the Professional label because assessment is explicitly multiple choice rather than hands-on administration.
